questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The Z-line marks the boundaries of each sarcomere and serves as the attachment point for actin myofilaments.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This cross section of a skeletal muscle fibers shows numerous myofibrils that fill the cell. Myofibrils, in turn, contain bundles of myofilaments. The presence of a peripheral nucleus indicates that this is a skeletal muscle fiber, not a cardiac muscle fiber which has a centrally-located nucleus.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The sacromere is the basic contractile unit of striated muscle and extends from Z-line to Z-line. Due to the alignment of the myofilaments within the myofibril, the banding pattern extends across the entire diameter of the myofibril.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The A-band is formed by the overlap of the myosin and actin myofilaments and, thus, appears darker than the adjacent I bands, which contain actin only.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This longitudinal section of cardiac muscle demonstrates how the muscle fibers branch and interlace. Also visible are intercalated discs, which are diagnostic for cardiac muscle. Striations in cardiac muscle fibers are less prominent than in skeletal muscle fibers.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This cross section of skeletal muscle demonstrates the peripherally located nuclei and numerous myofibrils that fill the sarcoplasm. The combination of these features identifies skeletal muscle.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The endomysium is the delicate connective tissue surrounding individual skeletal muscle fibers.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Myofibrils are longitudinally-oriented in the sarcoplasm of striated muscle. Thus in cross section they appear as small circular dots. Myofibrils consist of longitudinally-oriented myofilaments. In this section of skeletal muscle, note also the peripherally-located nuclei.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This image shows a longitudinal section of smooth muscle. Smooth muscle fibers are the smallest fiber type and are spindle shaped, that is, they taper at their ends. This shape allows them to form dense sheets of muscle which often form the walls of hollow organs. Smooth muscle fibers are not striated.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The intercalated disc is the complex cell junction between adjacent cardiac muscle fibers. The disc is diagnostic for cardiac muscle and is prominent due to the concentration of proteins at this junction.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The A-band is formed by the overlap of myosin and actin myofilaments and, thus, appears darker than the adjacent I bands, which contain actin myofilaments only.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This cross section of cardiac muscle demonstrates the centrally-located nucleus of cardiac muscle fibers and the presence of myofibrils. This combination of features identifies cardiac muscle.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This cross section of smooth muscle demonstrates the centrally located nucleus of smooth muscle fibers. The nucleus, which is located midway along the longitudinal axis of the fiber, is not visible in all fibers due to the random plane of section through the tissue. In addition, the cross sectional profiles of the fibers varies due to the spindle shape of the fibers. No myofibrils are present.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Skeletal muscle fibers are unbranched cylinders with multiple, peripherally-located nuclei. Also visible are the heavy cross striations.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Intercalated discs in this longitudinal section of cardiac muscle are very prominent. Intercalated discs are complex cell junctions between adjacent cardiac muscle fibers and are unique to cardiac muscle. They provide attachment as well as ionic continuity between adjacent fibers.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the tissue that fills the field.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This cross section of skeletal muscle demonstrates peripherally-located nuclei and myofibrils. The combination of these features identifies skeletal muscle.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: CORRECT.  The Z-line marks the boundaries of each sarcomere and serves as the attachment point for actin myofilaments.
